text: Mira: I will send the revised forecast by Tuesday. Chair: Thank you. No later update is present.
Chair: Mira, can you test the form? Mira: Yes, I will test it this afternoon.
Mira: Put my name against the supplier comparison. I will prepare it for next week.
Mira: I can do the review. Chair: Actually, cancel that; the review is no longer needed.
Jon: I will own the budget update. Mira: Thanks, Jon.
Mira: I already sent the forecast yesterday. Chair: Received, nothing else needed.
Mira: Perhaps someone should test the form. Nobody is assigned or volunteers.
Chair: Could Mira check the forecast? Mira has not responded.
